rows.grounds: fused form ca+aṣṭa-droṇaiḥ+ca indicating quantity and accompaniment
material used for preparing the platform

items.question: What material preparation is prescribed for the ritual platform on the altar?
premises: A ritual platform is to be prepared on the altar.
The preparation involves eight droṇa measures.
The specified material for this preparation is rice grains.
items.inference: The ritual procedure requires forming a platform on the altar using eight droṇa measures of rice grains.
uncertainties: The exact volume denoted by a droṇa in this context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Prepare a ritual platform on the altar with eight droṇa measures of rice grains.
